claim: Patchline ships a stepped-wedge cluster trial rolling out gating across teams with pooled effect estimates. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the stepped-wedge trial claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make stepped-wedge-trial-gate`.
